plan.notes: Source: Suggested Course Sequence - Technical Certificate Management and Supervision (2026-2027 catalog, Business and Computer Science area; catalog prints term labels as plain 'Fall'/'Spring'). Genuine catalog discrepancy kept verbatim: the p.107 summary table prints 30 required credit hours, while the program section prints 'Total Credit Hours Required for Credential Completion: 27'; the sequenced sum is 27 and total_credits uses it. Choice slots use the first-listed option of each Program Requirements group. Catalog footnote kept verbatim: 'If electing to take Principles of Accounting I (ACCT 10003) to satisfy Finance Requirement, complete in the Fall term and complete Math Requirement in the Spring term.' The sequence table prints the Finance row as 'Principles of Finance BUSI 22543'; the slot encodes the Finance Requirement choice (first-listed ACCT 10003, full options).
